description: Development and held-out command-specific cases; never tune on holdout outputs.

cases.prompt: A duck becomes mayor. No dialogue.
Exactly three arcade racers speed toward a neon finish line while one says "Not today!"
An astronaut finds a handwritten note on Mars that says "back in five minutes". No speech.
Two rival chefs discover they are both cooking for the same very judgmental cat.
OALGO looks into the camera, says exactly "I want my money back.", then slowly raises one eyebrow. Make it 8 seconds.
OALGO silently inspects a tiny trophy, grins, and proudly holds it toward the camera. No speech or subtitles.
OALGO celebrates a winning trade, receives a phone notification that reverses it, and reacts with an original short complaint. Make it 12 seconds.
OALGO points to a card reading "NO REFUNDS", then says exactly "Read the sign." Preserve both texts verbatim.
A sleepy lighthouse keeper notices the lamp has become a miniature sun and carefully puts on sunglasses. No dialogue.
In 10 seconds, exactly two robots exchange a red umbrella in the rain. Neither robot changes color. No speech.
A tiny detective opens a matchbox and finds a glowing forest. Show opening, discovery, then a visible surprised reaction.
A continuous shot follows a paper boat through a puddle and ends at a storm drain. Stop before the boat falls in.
Two bakers argue over a burnt loaf. The first says "Your turn." The second replies "No chance." Preserve those words and speakers.
A theater marquee clearly reads "TONIGHT ONLY". A single moth lands between the words. No other visible text.
An orange cat taps a blue bell exactly three times, then sits. Keep the bell on the left throughout.
A silent claymation gardener offers water to a mechanical flower; it opens and reveals a small clockwork bee.
Make an 8-second loop of a glass marble circling a wooden bowl. Match the opening and closing composition. No cuts.
A camera tracks a green bicycle left to right as it crosses a bridge. The cyclist keeps facing forward.
A split scene sequence: a child draws a star, a match cut reveals the same shape on a spaceship window, then Earth appears outside. No dialogue.
A bookstore owner says exactly "We close at six." A wall sign reads "OPEN". Do not convert the sign to subtitles.
Exactly four penguins slide in a line, stop together, and bow together. No extra penguins or speech.
In 15 seconds show a chef placing a cake, a dog sneaking closer, and the chef catching the dog before it touches the cake.
A red balloon escapes a street magician and is caught by a passing cyclist. Keep the balloon red and show the handoff.
A formal perfume advertisement reveals the bottle is a tiny watering can. Elegant lighting, one short visual joke, no narration.
A candle flame turns into a small golden fish that swims through the air and returns to the wick. One continuous shot.
A stagehand quietly replaces a moon prop with a giant cookie. The audience is unseen. No dialogue or readable words.
A worried astronaut whispers exactly "Did you hear that?" while a loose wrench slowly rotates behind them. No second speaker.
A dog waits at an empty bus stop. A tiny bus arrives and a mouse driver opens the door. Show the dog noticing the impossible scale.
OALGO says exactly "Everything is fine." while his smile slowly turns into disbelief. Keep the wording unchanged.
OALGO silently balances a coin on his finger, loses it, and catches it against his chest. No speech, captions or narration.
OALGO presents an empty wallet to the camera and delivers one original short joke about trading fees.
In 10 seconds, OALGO reads a phone notification, looks up, and says exactly "Not again."
OALGO writes "SOLD OUT" on a small card and holds it toward the camera. No spoken dialogue.
OALGO greets a second character who stays offscreen. Only OALGO speaks, saying exactly "You came back."
OALGO moves from a disappointed whisper into a triumphant shout using the exact line "I knew it!" once.
A close shot of OALGO inspecting a toy rocket cuts to a wider view as he sets it on a table. Preserve his face and clothing.
OALGO proudly displays exactly two gold coins, gives one away offscreen, and shows the single remaining coin.
OALGO says exactly "No more shortcuts." while carefully tying a red ribbon around a tiny gift.
OALGO notices his coffee cup is empty, looks accusingly at the camera, and improvises one brief playful complaint.
In 8 seconds OALGO silently points left, realizes the prize is on his right, and turns only his eyes toward it.
OALGO holds a placard reading "PLAN B" and says exactly "We have a plan." Do not add subtitles.
OALGO excitedly counts down "Three, two, one!" and blows out one birthday candle. Keep every word.
OALGO tries to look serious while a paper crown slowly slides over one eyebrow. No dialogue.
OALGO says exactly "That was the last one." after discovering an empty snack bag. Keep the accent through the disappointed delivery.
OALGO unwraps a tiny trophy, examines it, and delivers a brief original acceptance speech. Make it 12 seconds.
OALGO first appears in a close-up, then a deliberate cut shows him seated at a table with the same face and flag clothing.
OALGO silently offers a folded paper bird to the camera; it flaps once and he looks pleasantly surprised.
OALGO looks from a falling chart on his phone to the camera and says exactly "I can explain." No translation or added words.
